```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1
```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(host_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(listing_count = dplyr::n())

A1 = host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(listing_count >= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_hosts = dplyr::n())

A2 = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::group_by(host_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(listing_count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(listing_count >= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarize(percent = 100 * sum(listing_count) / nrow(dplyr::filter(listings, city == "Chicago")))

A1
A2
```
## Task 2
```{r}
family_listings = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates)

neighbourhoods = family_listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price_per_person = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    listing_count = dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(listing_count >= 20)

A3 = neighbourhoods |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person)

A3
```
## Task 3
```{r}
city_room_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

A4 = city_room_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  )

A4
```
## Task 4
```{r}
columbus = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d))

top_10_count = ceiling(0.10 * nrow(columbus))

top_10_revenue = columbus |>
  dplyr::slice(1:top_10_count) |>
  dplyr::summarize(revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE))

total_revenue = columbus |>
  dplyr::summarize(revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE))

A5 = 100 * top_10_revenue$revenue / total_revenue$revenue

A5
```
## Task 5
```{r}
entire_homes = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")

october = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

joined = dplyr::inner_join(
  entire_homes,
  october,
  by = "id"
)

city_shares = joined |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    share = mean(nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

A6 = city_shares |>
  dplyr::arrange(share)

A6
```
## Task 6
```{r}
reviews_listings = dplyr::inner_join(
  reviews,
  listings,
  by = "id"
)

city_month_reviews = reviews_listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

twin_cities_reviews = city_month_reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

A8 = twin_cities_reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(total_reviews == max(total_reviews)) 

A9 = max(twin_cities_reviews$total_reviews) /
  min(twin_cities_reviews$total_reviews)

A8
A9
```
## Task 7
```{r}
superhost_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost == "t" | host_is_superhost == "f"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

superhost_summary
```

```{r}
listing_shares = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(listing_count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    share = 100 * sum(listing_count[listing_count >= 10]) / sum(listing_count)
  )

listing_shares
revenue_shares = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_revenue = sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d[1:ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(share = 100 * top_10_revenue / total_revenue)

revenue_shares
```
